title: Microsoft Edge: v.157 - Updated performance information in tab hover cards
description: Microsoft Edge is updating tab hover cards to provide clearer information about tab memory usage and memory savings when inactive tabs are discarded. Users will also have separate settings for tab-preview images and memory-usage information.
